target.title: docs(changelog): add missing PR #92654 (right-click Reply in Dashboard webchat)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where PR #92654 (feat(control-ui): add right-click Reply in Dashboard webchat) was merged and included in the 2026.7.1 release but is not listed anywhere in CHANGELOG.md — neither in the grouped change summaries nor in the complete contribution record at the bottom.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds the missing PR in two locations that follow the existing CHANGELOG conventions:

1. **Changes → CLI and node workflows** — added right-click Reply in Dashboard webchat alongside the other UI/workflow features in that group.
2. **Complete contribution record** — added the PR entry with attribution in the audited PR list.

Also credits @vincentkoc who contributed code to the original PR.

## User Impact

No user-facing impact beyond the CHANGELOG itself. Users and contributors browsing the release notes will now see the complete list of changes.

## Evidence

- Searched CHANGELOG.md for "92654": no results (confirmed the PR is absent).
- Original PR: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92654
- The PR is confirmed merged and included in the release.
- @vincentkoc's commits appear in the original PR commit log: `gh api repos/OpenClaw/OpenClaw/pulls/92654/commits --jq '.[].commit.author.name'` returns "Vincent Koc".
